+def read_requirements(fh: Any, resolve: bool=True) ->Generator[Package,
+    None, None]:
+    """
+    Read requirements from a file handle and yield Package objects.
+    """
+    contents = fh.read()
+    
+    # Determine the filename for dparse
+    filename = getattr(fh, 'name', 'requirements.txt')
+    
+    if not is_supported_by_parser(filename):
+        filename = 'requirements.txt'
+    
+    dependency_file = parse(contents, file_type=filetypes.requirements_txt)
+    
+    packages: Dict[str, Package] = {}
+    
+    for dep in dependency_file.dependencies:
+        # Skip VCS/URL requirements
+        if dep.extras and not dep.name:
+            continue
+        
+        name = dep.name
+        if not name:
+            continue
+        
+        # Skip VCS requirements (those with no valid name or URL-based)
+        dep_str = str(dep.extras) if dep.extras else ''
+        
+        found = filename
+        
+        try:
+            req = parse_requirement(dep, found)
+        except Exception:
+            continue
+        
+        # Skip VCS/editable requirements
+        if req.url:
+            continue
+        
+        pkg_name = canonicalize_name(name)
+        
+        if pkg_name not in packages:
+            packages[pkg_name] = Package(
+                name=pkg_name,
+                version=None,
+                requirements=[req],
+                found=found,
+                insecure_versions=[],
+                secure_versions=[],
+                latest_version=None,
+                latest_version_without_known_vulnerabilities=None,
+                more_info_url=None
+            )
+        else:
+            packages[pkg_name].requirements.append(req)
+    
+    # Handle recursive requirements files
+    if resolve:
+        base_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(filename)) if os.path.exists(filename) else os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(getattr(fh, 'name', '.')))
+        
+        for dep_file in dependency_file.resolved_files:
+            dep_file_path = dep_file if os.path.isabs(dep_file) else os.path.join(base_dir, dep_file)
+            if os.path.exists(dep_file_path):
+                try:
+                    with open(dep_file_path) as sub_fh:
+                        for pkg in read_requirements(sub_fh, resolve=resolve):
+                            pkg_name = canonicalize_name(pkg.name)
+                            if pkg_name not in packages:
+                                packages[pkg_name] = pkg
+                            else:
+                                packages[pkg_name].requirements.extend(pkg.requirements)
+                except Exception:
+                    pass
+    
+    for pkg_name, pkg in packages.items():
+        pkg.version = find_version(pkg.requirements)
+        yield pkg

+    applied_fixes = []

+    for file_path, file_data in files.items():

+

+        fixes_to_apply = file_data.get('fixes', {}).get('TO_APPLY', [])

+
+        updated_content = content
+
+        for fix in fixes_to_apply:
+            dependency = fix.dependency
+            if dependency is None:
+                fix.status = 'AUTOMATICALLY_SKIPPED_NOT_FOUND_IN_FILE'

+
+            if no_output:
+                fix.status = 'SKIPPED_BECAUSE_OUTPUT_IS_NOT_TERMINAL'
+                continue
+
+            try:
+                updated_content = dependency.serialize().serialize(updated_content, fix.updated_version)
+                fix.status = 'APPLIED'
+                applied_fixes.append(fix)

+                LOG.error(f'Error applying fix: {e}', exc_info=True)
+                fix.status = 'AUTOMATICALLY_SKIPPED_UNABLE_TO_FIX'
+
+        for fix in fixes_to_confirm:

+                    f.write(updated_content)
+            except Exception as e:
+                LOG.error(f'Error writing file {file_path}: {e}', exc_info=True)
+
+    return applied_fixes

+def read_requirements(fh: Any, resolve: bool=True) ->Generator[Package,
+    None, None]:
+    
+    packages = {}
+    req_files = {}
+    
+    is_path = isinstance(fh, str)
+    
+    if is_path:
+        try:
+            with open(fh) as f:
+                content = f.read()
+            found = fh
+        except Exception:
+            return
+    else:
+        try:
+            content = fh.read()
+            found = getattr(fh, 'name', 'unknown')
+        except Exception:
+            return
+    
+    if not is_supported_by_parser(found):
+        filetype = filetypes.requirements_txt
+    else:
+        filetype = None
+    
+    try:
+        df = parse(content, file_type=filetype, path=found, resolve=resolve)
+    except Exception:
+        return
+    
+    for dep in df.dependencies:
+        if dep.is_vcs or dep.is_file_path:
+            continue
+        
+        if not dep.name:
+            continue
+        
+        name = canonicalize_name(dep.name)
+        
+        try:
+            req = SafetyRequirement(dep.name, found=found)
+            if hasattr(dep, 'extras'):
+                req.extras = dep.extras
+            if hasattr(dep, 'specs'):
+                req.specifier = SpecifierSet(str(dep.specs))
+            elif hasattr(dep, 'specifier'):
+                req.specifier = dep.specifier
+            if hasattr(dep, 'hashes'):
+                req.hashes = dep.hashes
+        except Exception:
+            continue
+        
+        version = find_version([req])
+        
+        if name in packages:
+            pkg = packages[name]
+            pkg.requirements.append(req)
+            if version and not pkg.version:
+                pkg.version = version
+        else:
+            pkg = Package(name=dep.name, version=version, requirements=[req], found=found, insecure_versions=[], secure_versions=[], latest_version=None, latest_version_without_known_vulnerabilities=None, more_info_url=None)

+                    for r in pkg.requirements:

+        def collect_params(context):

+def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
+    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
+    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
+    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
+    available_width = columns - len(start_line_decorator) - len(end_line_decorator)
+
+    wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
+        width=available_width,
+        initial_indent=indent,
+        subsequent_indent=sub_indent if sub_indent else indent,
+        break_long_words=False,
+        break_on_hyphens=False,
+    )
+
+    wrapped_lines = wrapper.wrap(text) if text.strip() else ['']
+
+    if max_lines is not None and len(wrapped_lines) > max_lines:
+        wrapped_lines = wrapped_lines[:max_lines]
+
+    result_lines = []
+    for line in wrapped_lines:
+        padded = start_line_decorator + line + end_line_decorator
+        if color:
+            padded = click.style(padded, fg=color)
+        result_lines.append(padded)
+
+    return '\n'.join(result_lines)

+def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
+    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
+    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
+    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
+    unstyled_text = click.unstyle(text)
+    
+    wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
+        width=columns,
+        initial_indent=indent,
+        subsequent_indent=sub_indent if sub_indent else indent,
+        break_long_words=False,
+        break_on_hyphens=False,
+    )
+    
+    wrapped = wrapper.fill(unstyled_text)
+    
+    if color and not styling:
+        wrapped = click.style(wrapped, fg=color)
+    elif styling:
+        wrapped = click.style(wrapped, **styling)
+    
+    result = start_line_decorator + wrapped + end_line_decorator
+    
+    return result
